meta.description: Meet Northline Appliance Repair, a local family-owned team fixing refrigerators, washers and dryers around Austin since 2012. Licensed, insured and local.

overview: Local, family owned and focused on fixing it right the first time.

intro: Northline started in 2012 with one van and a simple promise: tell people the price before the work, and stand behind the repair. Dana Example still runs the shop the same way.

body: Every technician is licensed, insured and background checked. Every repair carries a 90-day warranty on parts and labor, and every customer gets a written price before we start.

closing.body: Book your first repair and see why your neighbors keep calling us back.
